'''Melchi's Medical Relief''' was an organization run by the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Melchi]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Mecetti Purge]] of [[House Pelagia]], Melchi took command of the damaged [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Benevolence]]'' and began conducting relief efforts in orbit of [[Pelagon]]. Due to his efforts, House Pelagia rewarded Melchi by giving him the medical frigate and encouraging him to operate as a mobile relief ship throughout the sector. Melchi agreed, and began to assist in disaster areas and war zones. The operation was funded by the [[Great Council (Tapani Federation)|Great Council]]. However, the relief work was also a cover for Melchi's alliance with House Pelagia. Due to Melchi being able to move between provinces without suspicion, he also operated as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Spy/Legends|spy]], helping to restore prestige and power to House Pelagia.<ref name="LE" />
